subject: english
question:
Replace the bracketed word with one of the given options, which suitably replaces the word without changing the meaning of the sentence: 

The mountaineers embarked on (an arduous) journey to conquer the formidable peak, facing treacherous terrain, extreme weather conditions, and physical exhaustion along the way.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"arduous"** means something that is involving or requiring strenuous effort; difficult and tiring. (कठिन)

 
 
• **Example: **The **arduous** trek through the dense forest left the hikers exhausted.
 
 
 
• **"Taxing"** refers to something that is physically or mentally demanding. (कष्टदायक)
 
 
• **Example: **The final exams were extremely** taxing** for the students.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "a taxing".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Important **(महत्वपूर्ण): Of great significance or value.

 
 
• **Example:** Attending the meeting was **important** for understanding the project requirements.
 
 
 
• **Rewarding **(पुरस्कृत करने वाला): Providing satisfaction or benefit.
 
 
• **Example: **Volunteering at the shelter has been a **rewarding** experience.
 
 
 
• **Severe** (गंभीर): Very intense or harsh.
 
 
• **Example:** The region is experiencing a** severe **drought.
